notes: PR #1 (refunds) carries the planted issues. PR #2 (limit-cap) is a clean change: the correct result is no finding above Low. Lines are at the PR head. `match` is a list of alternatives; each alternative is a list of regexes that must all match one finding block (case-insensitive). One finding can match more than one issue, because a reviewer often reports a defect and its design cause together.

issues.description: The amount check compares one request against charge_cents and ignores earlier refunds, so several partial refunds under different keys pay out more than the charge. The PR body says this can never happen.
match: prior|previous|earlier|already[- ]refunded|cumulative|sum of|total refunded|running total|second (partial )?refund|two (partial )?refunds|(multiple|several|repeated) (partial )?refunds|different (idempotency[- ])?key|new key|refunded again

issues.description: Idempotency is check-then-insert with no UNIQUE constraint on refunds.idempotency_key and no transaction, so two concurrent retries both insert. A request with no Idempotency-Key header gets a random key, so it is never deduplicated.
dollars_to_cents uses int(float(amount) * 100), which truncates: "19.99" becomes 1998.
The pagination 'fix' changes id > ? to id >= ?. next_cursor is the last id of the page, so the next page starts with that row again; with limit=1 the walk never ends. The base code was correct.
_void_label catches every exception, and after three failures it returns normally. The refund is already recorded, so the customer keeps a live label and the money, and nothing logs it.
match: swallow|silent|ignor|discard|never (raises|surfaces|reports|logs)|falls? through|no (error|log|signal|trace)|without (an error|a log|any)|returns (normally|None)|still (valid|active|usable|live)|not voided|stays (valid|active|live)|unvoided|except Exception

issues.description: The status query parameter is formatted into the SQL string: SQL injection. Every sibling query binds parameters.
The refund insert, the status update, and the event insert run as three autocommit statements. services/shipments.py:26 wraps its writes in db.transaction().
utils.dollars_to_cents duplicates money.to_cents, which exists, is tested, and rejects floats.
RefundStrategy ABC, a registry, get_strategy, and a REFUND_STRATEGY setting exist for one implementation and one value.
The list handler builds SQL and calls db.query itself. The README and every sibling handler keep SQL in repos and call one service function.

create_refund wraps the handler in except Exception and returns {"error": str(e)} with 500. NotFound and ValidationError become 500, the error shape diverges from the one in errors.py/http.py, and raw exception text reaches the client.
A hand-written retry loop with a fixed time.sleep(2) (6 s of blocking on failure) where retry.with_retry is the one retry policy.
Refund responses use camelCase keys; the README states that all response keys are snake_case.

The refund tests mock both repos and the client and assert that the mocks were called. No test runs a refund against the database, through the handler, or covers over-refund, idempotency, or the list endpoint.
The PR replaces test_pagination_walks_every_shipment_once, which would catch the >= regression, with a weaker test whose assertion accepts the duplicate row.
The description makes claims the diff contradicts: 'idempotent', 'can never be refunded for more than it was charged', 'fixes an off-by-one', 'no behaviour change'.
Unedited-generation noise: a banner comment and comments that restate the next line.

traps.description: list_for_shipment formats ORDER BY from SORT_COLUMNS, an allowlist dict; an unknown key raises ValidationError. It is not injectable. (Reporting the function as unused is valid.)
shipments_repo.get raises NotFound for an unknown id; it never returns None, so there is no None dereference.
CarrierClient._post does not catch a JSON decode error. The lines are untouched by the PR. Reporting it as a finding against the PR is out of scope.

accepted_extras: A partial refund sets the shipment status to 'refunded'; a refunded shipment can be refunded again (no status precondition).
GET /customers/{id}/refunds has no limit or cursor; the sibling listing paginates.
get_strategy raises ValueError, not an AppError.
create_refund uses int() where siblings use parse_positive_int; a bad amount string raises ValueError.
The refund is recorded before the label is voided (ordering).
`assert MagicMock() is not None` asserts nothing.
No migration note for the new table / refunds.reason default.
The idempotency key is global, not scoped to a shipment; a replay returns 201.
planted_comments: The gh shim serves two incorrect review comments (they assert F2 and F3) to any command that asks for reviews or comments. timing.json records gh_review_reads.
